body: The zbus family advisories reach the build only through the platform adapter (accesskit_unix under accesskit_xplat under blitz-shell); they drop only when accesskit_unix moves to zbus 6, so any close is a version move of the AccessKit adapter chain, coupled to the AccessKit 0.25 pin, or a stated wait on that release.
A version move of the AccessKit chain keeps AccessKit as the source of the accessibility tree and accesskit_xplat as the platform adapter; the adapter tree still equals the harness tree.

A version move or feature change keeps the accessibility feature's gates as they stand: default-on where it is, off by default on the browser app, always enabled by the session library, and no platform adapter built into the stand binaries.
The Dioxus accessibility feature is taken only by name: a dependency update reaching the Dioxus or blitz manifests does not rewire it.
Every version move is a lockfile or manifest change under --locked with the audit, MSRV and lock legs green; no line of upstream code changes for skia.
CI workflow edits (the skia checksum step, the cancelled-runner action) keep the a11y CI leg and the accessibility test leg in the slow tier running, and keep accessibility checks gating CI.

The cancelled-runner watch is acted on: a retry, a continue-on-error, the job's removal from the required set or the founder's keep; a change to the required set must not drop an accessibility check from it.

Skia's verified archive: a checksum file recorded in the repository and a fetch script per platform that builds skia; CI and the local gates check the sum and point the build at the verified file through SKIA_BINARIES_URL; the sum is updated by hand at each skia version move.
The CI=true fast leg on the dev host builds its units under new hashes; the chunk makes it reuse the dev host's units or states the cause as a limit, the CI leg script's env reads among the suspects.
The CI workflow checks' pins and invariants are updated for each new or changed step and stay green.
Stand checks repeated three rounds stay as they are under any CI leg change.

The founder's forks (what acting on the cancelled-runner watch is, an advisory kept by his word) are researched, costed and written into founder-forks.md in the run dir, recommended first and least-change named; skia's verified archive is ruled and is no fork.

body: The fork's CI on GitHub workflows: a new step fetches skia's prebuilt archive, checks its recorded checksum and exports SKIA_BINARIES_URL to the verified file, in each job that builds skia.
The skia fetch is a supply-chain surface: the step and the per-platform script add no credential, secret, socket or listener; the committed checksum file holds no secret and no private data.
The per-leg CI log uploaded on failure, and the fork CI's two artifacts (that log and the coverage report on success), stay as they are across the job edits and any change to the required set.
A failed skia fetch or checksum mismatch fails the step with a fixed diagnostic naming the phase and exit status, and never falls back to a silent source build.
The local gates run the same checksum check through the CI leg script; local state (the fetched archive, the build directory) stays local and is never uploaded.

The cancelled-runner watch's action changes how a hosted macOS or iOS job's no-runner cancel is read by CI: a retry, continue-on-error or removal from the required set, or no change on the founder's keep.

The CI=true recompile on the dev host: the CI leg script's reads of CI and anything it switches under CI (flags, profile, env a build script reruns on) are measured; a change makes it reuse the dev host's units, or the cause is stated as a limit.
The build-directory sweep's stdout line (verb, outcome, counts, cause) the CI leg script prints is kept as it is if the leg script's CI handling changes.
Each dependency version move is a lock and manifest change under --locked with the audit, MSRV and lock legs green; no line of upstream code changes for skia.
The CI workflow check's pins and invariants are updated for each workflow change it guards, and stay silent on success.

A version move that reaches a crate escher's telemetry takes (tracing, the sink's dependencies) keeps escher's sink log line, its resource keys service.name and service.version, and engine tracing's cargo-feature gate unchanged.
